optimizer_lineage: same model parent; fresh Adam/RNG/data cursor for each arm, not resume
phase_window_contract: all10 native future labels inside the unprotected reviewed source carry interval; no stitching; every real start represented in sampler map
candidate_gate: two2x physical source rollouts pass all fixed geometric/continuity/release/tempo gates before publication; no rejected source used

followup_evaluation.stability_gate: On+open+actual gap>=.06m+EEF-bowl>=.10m for10 consecutive steps; continue up to50 extra steps to observe bounded stability
followup_evaluation.comparison: same cases/seeds across both arms, validation not unseen test

data_intervention: Actual matched physical re-recording, only carry reference clock1x vs2x; noncarry actions remain original. No rejectedv1 data included. Model/state/action/norm unchanged.
